name: capell-app/hero
description: A page-top banner with a headline over a picture, looping video or rotating slides, with one background set for your theme.

healthChecks.label: Hero package surfaces, providers, and install health are discoverable by Diagnostics.

marketplace.summary: Give the top of your pages a headline over a photo, looping video or rotating slides, with separate media for phones.
marketplace.description: Put your headline over a photo, a video or a set of slides at the top of a page. Upload one version of your media for big screens and another for phones, and add a picture to show while a video loads. Videos are MP4 or WebM files of your own, as YouTube and Vimeo links aren't supported. By default a video plays silently on a loop and pauses once it scrolls out of sight. Slides move on every eight seconds and hold still under the mouse. A theme-wide background keeps every page's banner matching, and any banner or slide can choose its own picture.
marketplace.problem: The top of the homepage looks flat, and matching every page's banner means setting each one up by hand.
marketplace.outcome: Each page's banner matches your site's look, with video on big screens and a photo on phones if you choose.

faq.question: Can I play a video behind the headline?
faq.answer: Yes, from files you upload yourself, in MP4 or WebM, with separate versions for big screens and phones. A YouTube or Vimeo link can't be used.

faq.question: Does the video play with sound, and can visitors stop it?
faq.answer: By default it plays without sound, loops and pauses itself once someone scrolls past, and an editor can change each of those. Visitors always get a pause button. If you also upload a picture, it shows while the video loads.

faq.question: Can I have a few slides instead of one picture?
faq.answer: Yes. Slides change every eight seconds and wait while a mouse rests on them. With no slides added, the banner shows the hero title and text saved on the page itself.

faq.question: Do I set a background on every page's banner?
faq.answer: No. Set a background for your theme and every page's banner follows it. One banner or one slide can still have its own picture, or none at all.
